correctness.rationale: Geometric swept-area of projected Minkowski sum gives S_H=A|Z|+H sqrt(1-Z^2)w_B(phi+pi/2) for Haar projection normals; |Z| uniform[0,1] independent of phi. Five elementary exact spherical moments establish mean A/2+pi H beta/4 and second-moment variance. Differentiating normalized F_q(s) yields [(2-pi)+(4q-pi)s]/[6(1/2+pi s/4)^3], q>=1, giving single positive minimizer and sharp value. Jensen and continuity give constant-width iff q=1. For triangular base exact extrema min{A,sqrt3 t} and max sqrt(A^2+4t^2), so worst-view optimizer H=sqrt3/2, versus H*=1.035995798...

final_claim: For every finite right prism over any compact convex planar base, random projected-area squared CV has unique height H*=A beta (pi-2)/(4 eta-pi beta^2), optimized value increasing in normalized second width moment eta/beta^2, with equality exactly constant-width bases; equilateral triangular worst-view height differs from CV-optimal height.
limitations: Only right prisms over compact convex planar B, uniformly random Euclidean orthogonal projection, full height H; not oblique prisms, area distribution or other dispersion losses.
